class.name: ImageFrames
class.brief_description: A sequence of image frames with individual durations.
class.description: [ImageFrames] loads, stores, and saves animated GIF frames. Each frame contains an [Image] and a duration in seconds. Editor imports can convert GIF files to [AnimatedTexture] or [SpriteFrames] resources.

method.name: add_frame
method.description: Appends [param image] with its display [param duration] in seconds. The duration must be greater than [code]0.0[/code].

method.name: get_bounding_rect
method.description: Returns the smallest rectangle starting at [code]Vector2(0, 0)[/code] that encloses every frame image.

method.name: get_frame_duration
method.description: Returns the duration in seconds of the frame at [param index].

method.name: get_frame_image
method.description: Returns the image of the frame at [param index].

method.name: load
method.description: Loads a GIF from [param path], replacing existing frames. If [param max_frames] is greater than [code]0[/code], stops after that many frames. Returns [constant OK] on success.

method.name: load_gif_from_buffer
method.description: Loads GIF-encoded [param data], replacing existing frames. If [param max_frames] is greater than [code]0[/code], stops after that many frames. Returns [constant OK] on success.

method.name: save_gif
method.description: Saves the frames to [param filepath] as a GIF. Multiple frames repeat [param loop_count] times, where [code]0[/code] loops forever, and preserve durations with GIF's hundredth-of-a-second precision. [param color_count] is clamped from [code]2[/code] to [code]256[/code] and rounded up to a power of two. Images that do not fit exactly in the palette use deterministic RGB quantization. Pixels with alpha below [code]0.5[/code] are transparent.

method.name: set_frame_duration
method.description: Sets the duration in seconds of the frame at [param index]. The duration must be greater than [code]0.0[/code].

method.name: set_frame_image
method.description: Replaces the image of the frame at [param index].
